{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Check how many rows have missing values in flipper_length_mm or body_mass_g
missing_flipper = penguins['flipper_length_mm'].isna().sum()
missing_mass = penguins['body_mass_g'].isna().sum()

# Check if the missing values are in the same rows
missing_both = penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].isna().all(axis=1).sum()

# Show the count of rows with missing values in either variable
print(f"Rows with missing flipper_length_mm: {missing_flipper}")
print(f"Rows with missing body_mass_g: {missing_mass}")
print(f"Rows with missing both: {missing_both}")

# Check if the missingness is systematic by looking at the species and sex of the missing rows
missing_rows = penguins[penguins[['flipper_length_mm', 'body_mass_g']].isna().any(axis=1)]
print("\nSpecies and sex of missing rows:")
print(missing_rows[['species', 'sex']].value_counts())"}
